usage.small_ui: Use the original32px SVG glyph, not a tiny3Drender.

usage.word_signs: Illustration/media only. Keep essential headings, body and controls as live native text; do not replace them with word-sign bitmaps.
usage.motion: Use the GLB for real turns. A PNG/WebP is a static rendering and cannot prove rotatable geometry by itself.
